result.title: Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives
result.summary: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. Using a fixed-length slide embedding, CLEAR-WSI refines retrieved candidates with either a predicted diagnostic label or the ground-truth label, depending on the retrieval setting. Newly processed cases are subsequently added to the expanding memory bank, allowing the retrieval archive to grow over time. On a comprehensive benchmark consisting of two public and one private clinical datasets representing four retrieval tasks, CLEAR-WSI improves Precision@5 over the strongest evaluated baseline, with gains on CAMELYON16 (3.10), BRACS-1 (2.75), BRACS-2 (1.95), and X-HER2 (3.75). Additional ablation and latency studies further examine the contribution of each component and highlight its potential for scalable deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CLEAR-WSI，用固定长度切片嵌入做病理全切片图像的诊断驱动检索，并通过诊断标签重排候选、增量扩充记忆库，在公开与临床数据上评估检索精度与延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于病理图像检索的工程应用，未涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据筛选机制或 latent 轨迹的训练与使用，压缩嵌入与记忆库仅服务于检索排序，与 LVR 主线缺乏具体可核查的状态或决策联系。
